name: ai-anti-slop
description: Hide x.com posts by accounts on a self-updating AI-reply spam list, and optionally mute them on X, daily or all at once. No X API.

scripts.check: node scripts/build-userscript.mjs --check && node --check dist/x-slop-hide.user.js && node --test 'test/*.test.mjs' && node --test 'server/test/*.test.mjs'
